warnings: Pile caps on hollow hexagonal piles Dia. 0.15 x 6.00 m (เสาเข็มหกเหลี่ยมกลวง): F1 6 piles, F2 9, F3 12, F4 16, all at 0.45 m centres with 0.15 m edge distance. No pile safe load is printed on this sheet.

main_bar.count is the two-way total (section 6b). F2 and F4 print 'N+N-DB12'; F1 and F3 print the two directions on two leaders: the leader on a cut bar (dot) is the set running along the short side, the leader on the drawn bar line is the set along the long side (bars_by_direction).

Cap thickness (height_mm) is the concrete only: 0.25 / 0.30 / 0.30 / 0.35; the 0.05 lean concrete 1:3:5 and 0.05 compacted sand under it stay in their own fields. The 1.00 from ระดับดินเดิม to the top of every cap is printed against a level with no value, so it stays on the elements (ground_reference), not in z_levels.
Column C1 stands at the centre of every cap (marked C1 in each plan view); its section is on S-06.
